findings.evidence: The spec calls for two short thick upright ears, but the ears are tall, long, tapered classic bunny ears that rise well above the head and dominate the silhouette.
The arms hang close to the torso, at roughly 10-15 degrees rather than the requested 25-degree A pose.
The body and feet are turned more than the requested 10 degrees, and one boot is placed slightly ahead of the other instead of a symmetric stance.
The hands show sculpted finger separations and curled digits, reading more as gloves than the requested rounded mittens.
